test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 17 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In the series 11, 19, 27, 35, 43, ........ which of the following will NOT be a number of the series?
solution:
**Given:**

11, 19, 27, 35, 43, ......

**Concept Used:**

aₙ = a + (n – 1) d

**Calculation:**

⇒ First term, a = 11 and Common Difference, d = 19 – 11 = 8

⇒ Checking for each term, the n value should be integer.

⇒ 434 = 11 + (n – 1) × 8

⇒ n – 1 = (423)/(8) = 52.875

⇒ This value will not be possible in this series, as number of terms can't be in decimal.

⇒ 107 = 11 + (n – 1) × 8

⇒ n – 1 = (96)/(8)=12

⇒ n = 12 + 1 = 13

⇒ This is a 13th term in this series.

⇒ 307 = 11 + (n – 1) × 8

⇒ n – 1 = (296)/(8)=37

⇒ n = 37 + 1 = 38

⇒ This is a 38th term in this series.

⇒ 195 = 11 + (n – 1) × 8

⇒ n – 1 = (184)/(8)=23

⇒ n = 23 + 1 = 24

⇒ This is the 24th term in this series.

**Hence, the number which cannot be possible in this series is 434**
